text:
li (Content): Draft ready — product blog draft includes benchmark section + webinar CTA. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xYz... Please quick-pass messaging + lead-routing. Target publish Wed EOD.

maria (Marketing): :eyes: reading now. Quick q — single CTA or dual CTA (hosted vs dedicated)?

li (Content): Prefer single primary CTA "Try Redwood Optimize" and secondary "Request webinar" inline. Secondary should map to webinar nurture list.

ben (PM): Can we shorten the benchmark section — customers want a TL;DR metric + methodology link. Also need a short quote from eng-ml.

sam (Design): Landing hero needs a smaller dashboard screenshot + new hero image from the latest console. I can mock in ~2h and post assets here.

tyler (Sales Ops): For lead routing: primary CTA -> SFDC lead_flow 'MKT_BLOG_TRY'; secondary CTA -> 'MKT_WEBINAR_NURTURE'. HubSpot UTM suggestion: `utm_source=blog`, `utm_campaign=benchhook_apr26`. Webhook mapping (staging):
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
payload: {"source":"blog","campaign":"benchhook_apr26","lead_flow":"MKT_WEBINAR_NURTURE"}
```

ana (Head of Marketing): Legal quick-pass needed on claims. Don't use hard '3x' wording without qualifier. Add 'typical' and link to eval methodology.

li (Content): Good call. Updated copy to: "typical unit cost reductions of 2–3x in West Coast workloads" and added methodology link (internal eval doc). Updated Google doc.

publish-bot: doc_locked by li (Content) at 3301234580 — lock for final pass

maria (Marketing): :thumbsup: copy approved from marketing. @sam please upload hero and dashboard shots. @tyler confirm webhook test by EOD.

tyler (Sales Ops): Running webhook test in staging now. Pinged @ben for webhook creds.

ben (PM): Sent creds to @tyler via 1:1. Ops prefer Thurs AM slot for go-live — can we aim for Thurs morning instead of Wed?

li (Content): OK moving publish to Thurs AM. Updated timeline in doc. Thanks everyone.
